guarantees.claim: Every element hw2reg.data_in[i].de is continuously assigned the value of data_in_we.

assumptions.claim: data_in_we must be glitch-free and properly synchronized to the receiving clock domain.
assumptions.cond: every cycle the block is active
assumptions.risk: glitches on data_in_we will cause unintended assertion of hw2reg.data_in[*].de, leading to spurious data writes into the data input registers.

formal_sketch.antecedent: every cycle the block is active

uncertain_points.claim: The loop bound NumRegsData must match the actual width of the hw2reg.data_in array; an inconsistency would cause out-of-bounds access.
uncertain_points.risk: synthesis/simulation may produce silently wrong connections if NumRegsData exceeds the array size, potentially leaving some elements unconnected or misconnected.

formal_sketch.consequent: The loop bound NumRegsData must match the actual width of the hw2reg.data_in array; an inconsistency would cause out-of-bounds access

security_implications: The block unconditionally propagates data_in_we to all data input register write-enables. If data_in_we is asserted erroneously (e.g., due to glitches, timing violations, or malicious control), unintended data writes could corrupt plaintext/ciphertext or cause data leakage through the shared data_in registers.
